name: Northport 'Reinventing Northport' redevelopment
status_detail: Operational · Block K container yard completed October 2024; wider transformation programme ongoing
summary: MMC's ongoing modernisation of Northport, the older half of Port Klang. Its latest milestone, the Block K container yard finished 51 days ahead of schedule in October 2024, lifted yard capacity to about 6.15 million TEU a year and brought electrified RTG cranes into service.

scale.label: Block K yard
scale.value: 2,016 total ground slots; +662,256 TEU a year (5-day dwell)

scale.label: Equipment
scale.value: 12 electrified RTG cranes procured for Block K

why_it_matters: Westports gets the headlines, but Northport's steady block-by-block rebuild decides whether Port Klang as a whole can absorb new volume. It is the quieter half of the port-capacity story behind the Selangor logistics corridor.
questions_to_follow: What comes after Block K and Block J in the Reinventing Northport plan?
Does Northport's berth capacity keep pace with its yard expansion as container ships get bigger?
location_precision: Northport terminals, Port Klang. Coordinates are port-area level from the port's UN/LOCODE listing (MYLPK).

sources.title: Northport's capacity and efficiency set to improve with new container yard

history.event: MMC Corporation takes over Northport and launches the Reinventing Northport transformation plan.
Block J container yard completed, adding 529,980 TEU to annual yard capacity.
Block K completed 51 days ahead of schedule; total yard capacity reaches 6,150,250 TEU per annum.
